cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: You Could at Least…
cards.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved this position for my wet sock: beside your dinner. It came through your puddle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you take it away? It's only water.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Removal is pending. You may explain why only water was worth leaving where I would step.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll wipe the floor. Just move the sock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Floor repair is approved. Add 'I'm sorry' and I'll authorize the sock's departure before your dinner absorbs any more of my evening.

reason: Make the visible sock and B practical repair offer part of A approval terms, with apology offering an easier route to dinner than further display.
